english: We're almost at that place.
Nothing so far, but…
Are they fortifying their defenses?
Most likely.
So they chose to concentrate their forces.
Or maybe each faction is focusing\non one of our teams?
Anyway, we just beat up whatever shows up!
Let's do our best, Red Angel!
Yeah!
What's wrong, Shirayuki-san?\nYou don't look so good.
I don't really know why, but…\nI have a bad feeling…
I have a bad feeling too, desuu.
Kinda gives me chills.\nBut I don't hate this feeling.
…No use dwelling on it.\nTimes like this, we trust our friends…!
//Battlefield map: Hinamizawa\n//Before our initial deployment. Conversation only.
It seems no one is here…?
Even I find that suspicious.
Usada, get to the front, nyo.
You go, Dejiko!
No — we all go together!\nHold this ground until Rika and the others arrive!
Indeed. I'll show you a battle worthy\nof this defender's blade.
Stand by to jump to the other world at once,\nand let's welcome Rika-chan and the others!
//Deploy our forces. Near the center of the map
Now we just wait!
It's so empty here —\nis the other team okay?
…They're coming!!
Huh?
//Enemies appear, completely surrounding us. Grunts of many types, everything they've got.
Nyoo!? That's way too many, nyoo!!
Encircle and annihilate — correct tactics.\nBut will it work on us, I wonder!
Right! We're used to fighting\nmountains of them!
This gets me fired up too!
This is OUR Hinamizawa!\nWe won't let you do as you please!!
I'll clean this up before Satoko-chan gets back!
Lovely ones galore, desuu!\nBut now I'll swallow my tears and smash them, desuu!
Ooh~… they're all coming at once…\nKinda nice… ufufu♪
Don't make that face!\nI'll put holes through the whole lot of 'em!!
//Battle start.
Ready or nooot!
Hm? Dejiko, did you hear something?
Kinda heard it, kinda didn't, nyo.
Okay, if you say so.
//At the start of turn 3, Mie's voice again
Ready or nooot!
Did I just hear a hide-and-seek voice, nyo?
See, I'm not imagining it!
But why hide-and-seek in the middle of a battle, nyo?\nI don't get it, nyo!
//At the start of turn 4, Mie's voice again
Reaaady or noooot!
Someone IS playing hide-and-seek, nyo!
But the one who says 'ready or not' is supposed to be IT, nyo!\nIt's weird for the hider to be shouting it, nyo!!
Hmm, hmm, but not yet~!
What's not yet, nyo!?
//From turn 5 on, after defeating a set number of enemies, Mie's voice again
Ah, they're here! Readyyy!!
What is it?
//Mie appears
Heheh, I got tired of waiting!
Wah! A-a little girl!
It's dangerous here.
Huh? That girl… have I seen her…?
Oh, long time no see, bunny-chan.
Aaah!! You're the kid who egged me on\nto beat up Dejiko!
This girl…?
They did say a girl about elementary-school age…
You're the mastermind?
Hmm, over there, maybe?
You're totally ignoring me!?
//Rin and Rika appear (it's Louise's illusion)
Ah! It's Rin-chan and Rika-chan!
Thank goodness, they're safe!
Gotcha!
//Mie closes in on Rika (the illusion) in an instant
Fast!!
Found you, Rikaaa!
Heheh, so that's the face you make?\nI'll play with you lots…
As my toy! Ahaha!!
This is bad!
Rika-chan! I'm coming!
Wait, that's not her!
//Kei appears. From a different direction than Mie
Mii. Error. That is…
Hweh?
//Houki and Louise appear
Got you!
Careless, weren't you!
//The Rin and Rika illusion vanishes
Huuuh~?
//The real Rin and Rika appear near Houki and Louise
That was an illusion Louise made!
An illusion.
//Laura, Kurumi, Cecilia, Satoko, Charlotte, and Puchiko also appear.\nEveryone moves toward Aria's main force
We broke through safely!
So, what is that girl?
She's about my age.
Don't let your guard down!\nThat girl's not normal!
…Ufufu! I see — I got outwitted!
//Event art: Mie laughing hard
Kyahahahaha!! Amazing — that's great!
I got close and they went shooom, gone!\nIt surprised me!
It was Louise's magic! But it looked\njust like the real thing from every angle!
K-chan, did you see that!?
//Event art off
Had mass and life signs been confirmed,\nit could have been avoided. A mistake.
Boo! That's your department, K-chan!\nI'm not doing that!
You two seem… quite close…?
They don't seem like bad people…?
Oh, right right! I got beaten, huh!\nYou're good, you guys!
Who ARE you!
I'm Mie!
Mie?
Huh? That's the same as my nickname!\nWhat's the big idea!
And over there is K-chan.
I am K-86X. Codename: Kei.\nNot 'K-chan'.
K-chan is fine!
Why are you targeting Rika-chan?
Well, you see…
//SE: comical fanfare, like 'tente-ke-teen!'
Because it looked fun!
You… what are you saying…?\nYou DO know where this is and what's happening,\nsaying that!
Yup, I know.
So casual, nyo!?
Very well. As a reward for getting one over on me,\nI'll specially tell you about me!
I'm a king, y'know!
A king?
That's right! I'll become the king who rules\neveryone's worlds — and makes them all fun!
Pleased to meetcha!
That's why you sweet-talked me into working for you!?
It was fun, wasn't it?
Are you the boss targeting me and Shirayuki?
Yup. Though Riko and Jeanne keep messing up.\nWanna join us?
What do you plan to do with us?
Oh my~? You know why you're being targeted, right~?
No fair hiding it!
No matter what, I won't hand Rika-chan\nand the others over to you!
That's fine. If you just handed them over,\nit'd be no fun!
I'll say it again! I'm the king\nwho'll conquer all the worlds!
Defying the king is… scaaary, y'know?
…We're done here. Bye.
I can't indulge in playing king.\nOne who stands above others needs\nthe virtue to match, you know?
Glad I got a look at the enemy's face.\nLater!
One last thing I'll teach you, nyo.
Kings are boys, nyo~!
//Polyal activates; our entire force vanishes.
I see! Girls are queens!\nK-chan, why didn't you tell me!
Because the possibility of Mii changing gender\nis not zero.
I see! Wait — I'm not changing!!
…But becoming a boy and making\nall of them my brides might not be bad…?
That is also acceptable.
But that's a hassle, so never mind!\nKyahahaha!!
//Fade to black\n//Background: Dokoka Town
Escape successful, I wonder~?
It looks like everyone's here!
Good work, everyone. Tifa and I will take\nthe first watch, so please get some rest.
If anything happens, I'll wake you right away.\nRest easy.
Rika, let's take Siesta and the others up on their offer\nand rest right away today.
Yes.
(We've escaped the worst situation —\nbeing trapped inside the loop… that's good.)
(But as before, Oyashiro-sama — that child —\nhasn't come with us. We'll have to settle this\nin Hinamizawa after all…)
//Fade to black\n//Background: Dokoka Town (night)
Siesta, anything unusual?
No. Dokoka Town has always been safe, and —\nthe Dokoka Card, was it? It seems you can't get in\nwithout one.
This town is strange.
Maybe it's like Albion, the floating continent\nof Halkeginia? You can only get there by flying.
Is this town's existence the work of magic, then?
Even if you ask me — a commoner —\nI wouldn't know.
Sorry, I just…
Just being in a world that isn't Halkeginia\nis strange enough. Maybe I've gotten\ntoo used to strange things?
True…
But we have so many reliable friends —\nit'll be fine!
Yes. Let's help however we can.
Now, back to patrol!
I'll keep at it!
//Siesta and Tiffania leave.\n//Eve's shadow appears there (darkish. Scary assassin-mode feel)
//Eve reveals herself. Like deactivating optical camouflage.\nDeliberately hiding her name so we can't tell if she's the real one or a fake.
(The rest are all asleep.\nLet's get this over with quickly.)
//END
